title: Blockworks: Important Systems
summary: Read the Blockworks signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Pattern cutters, family blocks, and worldgen site references let you build with the same visual language that ruined locations use.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch block families, pattern roles, palette consistency, site-kit purpose, and whether a player can read movement, storage, danger, and power at a glance.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Blockworks system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
